name: myosin heavy chain 11

function.text: MYH11 encodes myosin-11. Annotated molecular activities include microfilament motor activity and structural constituent of muscle. It participates in actomyosin structure organization and elastic fiber assembly.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to aortic aneurysm, familial thoracic 4 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Myeloid sarcoma; Acute myeloid leukemia. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
